description: SmartPixels-output emulator angle resolution (sigma) tables, v3 (inclusive; key = surface x cluster size x |cot|; variant 'own')

corrections.name: spix_emu_alpha_sigma
corrections.description: SmartPixels-output emulator cotAlpha resolution: weighted (q84-q16)/2 of (emitted - true) cot of the INCLUSIVE emulated population (class-T and class-C routes on the class-T clusters of the training events, weighted by the class fractions of the key cell), by surface code (1-4 IL, 11-14 ID) x cluster size along x (sizeX) and |reported cot| <= 12.0 (clamped above). Saturated rows excluded; bins merged from the data (>= 500 per route). Inputs are sensor-reported only (the cluster size is assumed sensor-reported).

inputs.name: sizeX
inputs.description: cluster bounding-box extent in pixels, local x

corrections.name: spix_emu_beta_sigma
corrections.description: SmartPixels-output emulator cotBeta resolution: weighted (q84-q16)/2 of (emitted - true) cot of the INCLUSIVE emulated population (class-T and class-C routes on the class-T clusters of the training events, weighted by the class fractions of the key cell), by surface code (1-4 IL, 11-14 ID) x cluster size along y (sizeY) and |reported cot| <= 12.0 (clamped above). Saturated rows excluded; bins merged from the data (>= 500 per route). Inputs are sensor-reported only (the cluster size is assumed sensor-reported).

inputs.name: sizeY
inputs.description: cluster bounding-box extent in pixels, local y
